_comment: Contact routes for public-records requests, keyed to the owner the resolver concludes. Every URL here was checked live on 2026-09-06; do not add an entry that has not been. This ships in the bundle and is dated, so anything read from it must render its provenance as bundled.

agencies.name: Maricopa County Department of Transportation
agencies.guidance: MCDOT takes records requests through its own form. Naming the road file number or project number, if the app found one, will get you to the right file much faster than a description alone.

agencies.name: Arizona Department of Transportation
agencies.mailingAddress: ADOT Risk Management, 1655 W. Jackson Street, MD 128A, Phoenix, AZ 85007
agencies.guidance: ADOT acknowledges a request within 7 business days. Non-commercial copies are $0.25 a page. A TRACS project number is the single most useful thing to quote — it is how ADOT files construction records, and bid results older than about four months exist only as records requests.

agencies.name: City of Goodyear
agencies.mailingAddress: City Clerk's Office, 1900 N. Civic Square, Goodyear, AZ 85395
agencies.guidance: Choose GENERAL RECORDS. Goodyear asks for an address and a date range, so quote the cross streets and give a decade if the app could not pin a year.
